info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Agate Drill Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Agate Drill Detail Catalog API allows businesses to create and manage detailed entries in the agate drill cataloging system. This API facilitates the submission of crucial information regarding agate drill specifications, ensuring accurate inventory records. Typical consumers include inventory managers, product developers, and e-commerce platforms that rely on detailed catalog information. Users can streamline their cataloging processes, improve data accuracy, and maintain up-to-date inventory records using this API.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create detailed information for an Agate Drill. By sending the required data, you can successfully add new specifications and attributes related to the Agate Drill, enhancing the overall database of drill details.

requestBody.description: This request body is designed to provide detailed specifications and parameters for the operation of the agate drill. It should include all relevant information required to initiate and manage the drilling process effectively.

200.description: The request was processed successfully and data is returned.

CreateCatalogAgateDrillDetailRequest.title: Agate Drill Details Request

agate_drill_id.description: Unique identifier for the Agate Drill.

requestedBy.description: Name of the person requesting the operation.

quantity.description: The quantity of Agate Drills requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority.

unitPrice.description: The unit price of each Agate Drill.

tags.description: A list of tags associated with the request.

items.description: A tag associated with the Agate Drill request.
